overview: Since sefef-web explicitly depends on sefef-api, a bottom-up ordering is applied: the API backend is built first as the foundation, then the frontend is layered on top. This ensures the contract (REST API, JWT auth, data shapes) is fully defined and testable before the React SPA is implemented against it. Building in this order also allows frontend developers to run integration tests against a real backend rather than mocking everything.

phases.name: Foundation — REST API Backend
phases.description: sefef-api has no dependencies on other components in this system, making it the natural starting point. It defines the full data model, authentication contract, and API surface that the frontend will consume.

components.name: sefef-api
responsibilities: Manage user lifecycle: registration with bcrypt password hashing, login with JWT issuance, logout with token revocation, and password reset via email or stdout fallback.
Enforce per-user data isolation across all task and category operations, ensuring every query is scoped to the authenticated user's ID.
Provide full CRUD for tasks with dynamic server-side filtering (status, category, due date range, keyword search), sorting, and computed overdue flagging.
Provide full CRUD for categories with unique-per-user enforcement; cascade category deletion to uncategorize affected tasks via DB ON DELETE SET NULL.
Run schema migrations at startup, expose a /health liveness endpoint that pings the database, and apply a layered middleware stack (logging, CORS, security headers, JWT auth).
components.architectureContext: sefef-api is the sole backend service in the system. It is called exclusively by sefef-web over HTTPS. It depends on a PostgreSQL database (external to this component graph) for all persistence. No other internal services call it. It owns the authoritative data model and all business logic — the frontend is a thin consumer of its REST API.
keyConsiderations: JWT sliding expiry: check if the token is in the last 50% of its TTL on every authenticated request and issue a refreshed token in the X-Refresh-Token response header — this must be consistent across all protected routes.

Dynamic SQL construction for GET /tasks must use parameterised queries exclusively (never string interpolation) to prevent SQL injection; build the WHERE clause and ORDER BY programmatically with an argument slice.
The revoked_tokens / JWT blocklist table must be cleaned up periodically (e.g., a background goroutine at startup) to prevent unbounded growth — purge rows where exp < NOW().
Password reset tokens must be stored as a cryptographic hash (e.g., SHA-256 of the raw token) so that a DB compromise does not yield usable tokens; the raw token is only ever in the email/log.
All user-facing errors must use the ErrorResponse schema with no internal detail leakage; log full errors server-side with request context (method, path, userID where available) for observability.
components.apiContract:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Sefef API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: Backend REST API for the Sefef task management application.
servers:
  - url: /api/v1
paths:
  /health:
    get:
      summary: Health check
      operationId: healthCheck
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Service is healthy
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  status:
                    type: string
                    example: ok
  /auth/register:
    post:
      summary: Register a new user
      operationId: registerUser
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuthRequest'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: User created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuthResponse'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
        '409':
          description: Email already in use
  /auth/login:
    post:
      summary: Log in
      operationId: loginUser
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuthRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Authenticated
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuthResponse'
        '401':
          description: Invalid credentials
  /auth/logout:
    post:
      summary: Log out
      operationId: logoutUser
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Session invalidated
  /auth/password-reset/request:
    post:
      summary: Request a password reset email
      operationId: requestPasswordReset
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [email]
              properties:
                email:
                  type: string
                  format: email
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Reset email sent if account exists
  /auth/password-reset/confirm:
    post:
      summary: Confirm password reset with token
      operationId: confirmPasswordReset
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [token, password]
              properties:
                token:
                  type: string
                password:
                  type: string
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Password updated
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
        '410':
          description: Token expired or invalid
  /categories:
    get:
      summary: List all categories for the authenticated user
      operationId: listCategories
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      responses:
        '200':
          description: List of categories
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Category'
    post:
      summary: Create a new category
      operationId: createCategory
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/CategoryRequest'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Category created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Category'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
  /categories/{categoryId}:
    parameters:
      - name: categoryId
        in: path
        required: true
        schema:
          type: string
          format: uuid
    put:
      summary: Rename a category
      operationId: updateCategory
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/CategoryRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Updated category
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Category'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
    delete:
      summary: Delete a category (tasks become uncategorized)
      operationId: deleteCategory
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Deleted
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
  /tasks:
    get:
      summary: List tasks with optional filters and sorting
      operationId: listTasks
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: status
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
            enum: [all, complete, incomplete]
            default: all
        - name: category_id
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
        - name: due_filter
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
            enum: [today, this_week, overdue]
        - name: due_from
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
            format: date
        - name: due_to
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
            format: date
        - name: priority
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
            enum: [low, medium, high]
        - name: sort
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
            enum: [due_date, created_at, priority]
            default: created_at
        - name: order
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
            enum: [asc, desc]
            default: desc
        - name: q
          in: query
          description: Keyword search against title and description
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: List of tasks
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Task'
    post:
      summary: Create a new task
      operationId: createTask
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskRequest'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Task created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Task'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
  /tasks/{taskId}:
    parameters:
      - name: taskId
        in: path
        required: true
        schema:
          type: string
          format: uuid
    get:
      summary: Get a single task
      operationId: getTask
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Task detail
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Task'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
    put:
      summary: Update a task
      operationId: updateTask
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Updated task
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Task'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
    delete:
      summary: Delete a task permanently
      operationId: deleteTask
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Deleted
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
  /tasks/{taskId}/complete:
    parameters:
      - name: taskId
        in: path
        required: true
        schema:
          type: string
          format: uuid
    patch:
      summary: Toggle task completion status
      operationId: toggleTaskComplete
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [complete]
              properties:
                complete:
                  type: boolean
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Updated task
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Task'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT
  responses:
    BadRequest:
      description: Validation error
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
    NotFound:
      description: Resource not found
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
  schemas:
    AuthRequest:
      type: object
      required: [email, password]
      properties:
        email:
          type: string
          format: email
        password:
          type: string
          minLength: 8
    AuthResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        token:
          type: string
        user:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/User'
    User:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        email:
          type: string
          format: email
        created_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
    Category:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        name:
          type: string
        created_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
    CategoryRequest:
      type: object
      required: [name]
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
          maxLength: 100
    Task:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        title:
          type: string
        description:
          type: string
          nullable: true
        due_date:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          nullable: true
        category_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          nullable: true
        category_name:
          type: string
          nullable: true
        priority:
          type: string
          enum: [low, medium, high]
          nullable: true
        complete:
          type: boolean
        overdue:
          type: boolean
          description: True when due_date is in the past and complete is false
        created_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        updated_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
    TaskRequest:
      type: object
      required: [title]
      properties:
        title:
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
        description:
          type: string
          nullable: true
        due_date:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          nullable: true
        category_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          nullable: true
        priority:
          type: string
          enum: [low, medium, high]
          nullable: true
    ErrorResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        error:
          type: string
        details:
          type: object
          additionalProperties:
            type: string

phases.name: Frontend — React SPA
phases.description: sefef-web depends on sefef-api being available to define the API contract, data shapes, and auth mechanism. It is built second once the backend surface is stable, enabling typed API client generation and real integration testing.

components.name: sefef-web
responsibilities: Provide a complete authentication UI (register, login, logout, password reset request and confirm) with client-side validation and JWT storage in localStorage, including silent token refresh via X-Refresh-Token response header handling.

Render a filterable, sortable, searchable task list with optimistic completion toggles, overdue highlighting, and an empty-state UI — all backed by React Query for server state with appropriate stale times.
Provide task create and edit flows (modal/slide-over) with full field support (title, description, due date, category, priority) and a confirmation-gated delete action.
Provide a category management UI (list, inline rename, deletion with uncategorize warning) integrated into the sidebar or settings menu.
Enforce route-level authentication via a PrivateRoute wrapper, globally intercept 401 responses to redirect to login, and apply XSS-safe rendering practices throughout.
components.architectureContext: sefef-web is the sole user-facing component. It makes HTTPS calls exclusively to sefef-api using the VITE_API_BASE_URL environment variable. It has no database or server-side logic of its own — Nginx serves the compiled static bundle and handles the SPA fallback routing. The backend is the authoritative source of truth; the frontend's React Query cache is a read-through layer on top of it.
keyConsiderations: The X-Refresh-Token header must be intercepted at the API client layer (not per-component) so token rotation is transparent application-wide — implement this as a centralized response interceptor in src/api/.

Optimistic updates for task completion toggles require careful React Query cache mutation: use onMutate to snapshot and update, onError to roll back, and onSettled to re-fetch — failure must surface a non-blocking toast, not a page-level error.

Search debouncing (300ms) must be implemented at the hook level and the debounced value (not the raw input state) passed to the React Query query key, so intermediate keystrokes do not trigger API calls.
The Nginx config must include the SPA fallback (try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html) to prevent 404s on direct navigation to client-side routes like /tasks/:id.

Category deletion race conditions (category_id set on a task but category_name is null) must be handled gracefully in the task card and detail view by falling back to displaying 'Uncategorized' rather than null/undefined.

openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Sefef Web (Static SPA)
  version: 1.0.0
  description: |
    This component is a React single-page application served as static files.
    It does not expose its own API endpoints beyond a health check path.
    All data operations are proxied to the sefef-api backend.
servers:
  - url: /
paths:
  /health:
    get:
      summary: Static health check
      operationId: webHealth
      responses:
        '200':
          description: App shell is being served
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  status:
                    type: string
                    example: ok
components: {}
